short_summary: Searched broadly for upcoming Polokwane-metro events (markets, gigs, sport, heritage, design fairs). WebFetch to almost all external domains was blocked by the network egress proxy this run, limiting verification to WebSearch snippets only, which repeatedly surfaced inconsistent/conflated dates (e.g. Capricorn Heritage Fest vs Doek On Fleek Lekompo Fest) and thin single-aggregator listings (Demi Lee Moore, Hotel & Home Design Fair, SKM Presents, Polokwane Melodic Festival, Botlokwa Braai Festival -- also outside Polokwane metro). Only the recurring Baobab Night Market at Meropa Casino cleared the 3-independent-non-resale-source bar (venue site suninternational.com, organiser Facebook/Instagram, and independent listing bizcommunity.com), published for its next two confirmed dates (30 Oct and 18 Dec 2026). 12 other candidates discarded for lacking independent corroboration or geographic scope.

WebFetch remained blocked by the network egress proxy this run (as last run), limiting verification to WebSearch snippets only. Searched broadly across markets, gigs, sport, theatre, family and food & drink categories. Two events cleared the 3-independent-non-resale-source bar: the Limpopo Holiday Fair at Savannah Mall (1-3 Oct 2026, corroborated by golimpopo.com/Limpopo Tourism Agency, ledet.gov.za and cdm.org.za) and the weekly Polokwane parkrun (corroborated by parkrun.co.za, the parkrun ZA blog, and the official Polokwane parkrun Facebook page). 14 other candidates discarded: several had conflicting/contradictory dates across sources (Kota Feast Polokwane claimed for 28 Nov vs the organiser's own official tour schedule placing 28 Nov in Bloemfontein; Carnival of Lights at Savannah Mall with conflicting May and October dates; a Mall of the North community day that turned out to be from October 2025 not 2026), several were in other towns outside the Polokwane metro (Robbie Wessels/Kameeldoring in Mokopane, Prisatt Boutique Hotel actually in Lephalale despite a ticketing site labelling it Polokwane, Blueberry Heights Farm in Haenertsburg, Uhuru Film Festival in Mokopane), and the rest (Run for Your Mind trail run, LBA & Elite Hoops basketball championships, Market at PLK Spring Edition) had only one or two corroborating sources rather than three independent non-resale ones.
